8bc709399b.text: Why did she just drag her large suitcase up the stairs?

007ae90d49.text: What did she put in the fridge? I'm so curious.

9b499414c7.text: Why would she spend so much money… on dyeing her hair?

63d79fa0e6.text: If she's really that rich, why would she… rent a room?

337e287772.text: …you won't believe it, there's a girl upstairs…

c9b1b06fdd.text: …her room is right next to mine…

b664d7ee1f.text: …she looks… so easy to push around…

3efe5166c1.text: …let me go in… take a look…

7d28802f46.text: …the trash… the hair… dyed it herself…

11b7d3560f.text: How dare she… do that… in my house.

63fd8530c4.text: She actually… told me to keep it down… in front of my friends…

ea8d77f1f0.text: …anyway, what are you doing this weekend?…

a29b2681a1.text: We're a family. We stick together.

435fa8ce62.text: …if anyone asks… we all say the same thing…

c1781f0cdd.text: It's just talking. It's not a big deal.

86667579bd.text: What's wrong with calling my friend?

58160fb62d.text: She has moved out at last.

fbf46b3d56.text: Going into her room? That never happened.
